title: CS2 signature database: one file per module (signatures/<module>.json)
description: Build-independent locators for every address the bridge relies on. Human reference: sigs/README.md. Validator/resolver: sigs/scripts/sigcheck.py. Generator (IDA): sigs/ida/ida_sigs.py.

_doc.description: free text for humans; ignored by tools

module.description: binary file name, e.g. hammer.dll (windows) or libclient.so (linux)

platform.description: which game build this file belongs to; default: by `module` suffix (.dll/.exe = windows, .so = linux). Windows files are PE (MSVC RTTI locators, image base 0x180000000) and are the ones the bridge gate covers; linux files are the ELF modules of the *other* build (steam.inf ClientVersion, e.g. 2000908) with image base 0 and itanium_vtable locators

image_base.description: 0x180000000 for a windows PE (IDA's default base, every doc address uses it); 0 for a Linux .so (its vaddrs are already RVAs)

builds.description: builds this file has been resolved against; key = CS2 ClientVersion from steam.inf (e.g. 2000921)

sha256.description: first 16 hex of the whole-file SHA-256

entries.description: keyed by name. Use the IDB/doc name (Class::Method, g_pFoo, Class for vtables, Class::m_field for offsets) or the bridge macro name for imported bridge anchors.

kind.description: what the resolved value is: function/vtable/global/string resolve to an RVA; offset and const resolve to an integer value (from the locator, or literally from `value` when no locator is given)

platform.description: override for the file's platform; it must equal it, because a file holds the entries of one binary (a linux entry lives in the lib<name>.so file, never in the .dll file of the same subsystem)

value.description: literal resolved integer for kind=const/offset entries without a locator: a layout number the game depends on that no binary locator derives (e.g. a vtable length known from RTTI, a subobject offset). Sourced only from bridge code verified live; `via` states file:line. sigcheck resolve returns it as-is and checks it against expect[build]. Not a binary check: with no locator, resolve cannot fail on it - the expect re-check is self-consistency only (see sigs/README.md).

ident_slot.description: kind=vtable only: slot whose function pointer the bridge checks for identity (contents compared, not called - catches a patched/proxied vtable). Read by `cargo bridge pins` when it emits the identity rows (pins.rs PIN_SLOTS); never hand-entered there.

struct.description: kind=offset only: C struct/class this field belongs to (bridge type name, e.g. CMapDoc). Grouping metadata for a future struct emitter; the offset itself is still resolved.

field.description: kind=offset only: field name inside `struct` (e.g. root). Embedded subobjects are marked "(embedded)" in `ctype`.

ctype.description: kind=offset only: C type of the field (e.g. "CMapRootElement *", "float", "u32", "char [128]").

structs.description: Retired: bridge_structs.h no longer exists (de-hardcode WP1b), so this flag changes nothing; an entry without a `bridge` macro or `sdk` is a measurement that is emitted nowhere. Kept so existing entries still validate.

via.description: where the site was chosen, as a human can re-find it in a disassembler on a new build: 'module!0x1800xxxxx (Class::Method, what the site does)'. Mandatory; this is the re-derivation hint when the locator stops matching.

tag.description: evidence tag for the *meaning* of the name (not for the locator, which is mechanical): V verified in disassembly, I inferred, RTTI from the RTTI name, S from the SDK headers, D from GameTracking dumps, ? unknown

expect.description: resolved value per build key (see builds). RVA for address kinds, integer value for offset/const. Written by `sigcheck.py resolve --record BUILD`; a hand-written value is a claim sigcheck will check.

bridge.description: the name the bridge binds this symbol by: emitted as a `pub const <name>: Pin` in crates/cs2-bridge/src/generated/pins.rs unless the entry carries `sdk`. Either way the entry is gated, fingerprinted and pinned (`cargo bridge pins`), and a vslot entry's runtime proof rows are named by it.

sdk.description: the generated SDK expression that owns this number (crates/s2sdk/s2sdk-sys/include/s2sdk_gen.h, gen.py's tie syntax: a sum of S2_* macros, `S2_SLOT_<...>*8` for a slot the game calls as a vtable byte displacement, and decimal addends). The bridge compiles that macro; the entry is the binary-side measurement: `cargo bridge pins` does not emit it as a pin (pins.rs) and refuses to write when the expression differs from the measurement (a vslot locator's slot index, else the resolved value), and sigs/scripts/sdkcheck.py reports an `sdk:` row for it. Windows entries of kind=function with a vslot locator (exactly one bare S2_SLOT_ macro), kind=offset or kind=const. Written by sigs/scripts/sdkadopt.py PIN=S2_EXPR (it checks the macro exists and equals the measurement), never typed.

status.description: proposed = generated, not yet resolved by sigcheck; verified = sigcheck expect matches; stale = failed on the newest build

allOf.description: value and locator are mutually exclusive: when a locator is present its result is used and a `value` would be silently ignored (validator rejects)
a literal `value` is only allowed on kinds that resolve to an integer (offset, const); function/vtable/global/string resolve to an RVA

symbol.description: itanium_vtable only: the exact `_ZTV…` mangled symbol of the vtable's class (e.g. _ZTV13CSchemaSystem). Use this when the class name alone is ambiguous; otherwise `class` is mangled for you

class.description: rtti: the MSVC class name (`CSchemaSystem`, or a full `.?AU…@@` name for a struct). itanium_vtable: the Itanium class name (`CSchemaSystem`, `A::B`), mangled to `_ZTV…`

measure.description: itanium_vtable only: resolve the vtable's slot count instead of its address (kind must be const). symbol = the exact length the linker records in the `_ZTV` symbol (st_size/8 - 2, the two header words); scan = the code-pointer run (the same scan as the vtlen locator, which under-counts a table whose last slot is a null)

steps.description: applied in order after the locator yields a start RVA

oneOf.description: sig: masked byte pattern, hex bytes or ?? separated by spaces, must match exactly once in `section` (default .text). Must start with a literal byte, be >= 8 bytes, and not be all wildcards.

refs.description: extra filters: the RIP-relative operand at +at (next instruction at +next) must point at this C string. Disambiguates short patterns.

oneOf.description: rtti: vtable of an MSVC class via its complete-object locator. class is the name inside `.?AV<class>@@`, or a full TypeDescriptor name starting with `.?A` (structs: `.?AU<name>@@`). col_offset selects a secondary vtable (offset of that base inside the object); default 0 = primary.

itanium_vtable: the address point (first virtual function) of an Itanium vtable, found by its `_ZTV…` symbol: `symbol` (exact mangled name) or `class` (mangled for you), + 16 to skip the two-word header (offset-to-top, typeinfo). With `measure` the entry instead resolves to the table's slot count (kind=const): `symbol` = the length the ELF symbol records (st_size/8 - 2, exact), `scan` = the code-pointer run (under-counts a table that ends on a null slot).
vslot: function pointer stored in slot N of a kind=vtable entry in the same file (slot 0 = first pointer after the RTTI locator).
string: RVA of a NUL-terminated C string that occurs exactly once in `section` (default .rdata).
base: start from another entry of this file (already resolved), then apply steps.

vtlen: length (in slots) of a kind=vtable entry of the same file: the number of leading .text-pointing 8-byte entries from the first slot after the RTTI locator to the first entry that is not a code pointer. Integer result, so the entry is kind=const.

step.description: exactly one of: call (follow E8 rel32 at +k), rip (follow RIP-relative disp32 at +rip; next = offset of the following instruction), deref (read the 8-byte image pointer at +k and continue there), rva (read the 4-byte image-relative offset at +k and continue there; MSVC RTTI COL/CHD/BCA fields), check (pattern must match at the current position), disp (read a signed displacement/immediate of `size` bytes at +disp -> value), add (value += n, or position += n when no value yet).
